name: @playform/style-dsh-material
description: The MATERIAL: the one place the family's UI base is developed (@playform/style-dsh-material) - the mixins, the base classes and the token expressions every client plugin's own stylesheet @uses over the harness alias tokens, so a new plugin extends the base instead of copying it. SCSS only and runtime-free: the Classic tree owns the source and the EffectTS plugins compile the same partials, the one cross-tree edge the family allows because a stylesheet has no Effect envelope.
